screen.channels: time, terminal voltage, current and cell temperature recorded for every sample; finite; time strictly increasing
screen.identity: one physical cell per file with a published identity
screen.initial_state: the protocol's declared initial state is attained: the preceding charge ends in CV at the protocol termination current plus the declared 10 mA current band (NASA: 20 mA + 10 mA; Chen 2020: C/100 = 50 mA + 10 mA), or the run starts from a declared rest whose state is fixed by the run's own protocol (Kirkaldy GITT: charge state 1 at the end of the pre-GITT rest by convention)
screen.model_family: a declared Thevenin 1RC family exists for the run kind: measured OCV (rest-ended GITT) or fitted piecewise-linear OCV (constant-current discharges)
screen.protocol_roles: the run kind is one the Gen1 families can pose (constant-current discharge then rest, or rest-pulse-rest) and the controlled current is a constant protocol level within each loaded segment
screen.provenance: publisher checksum or pinned sha256 for every raw file
screen.sample_density: loaded segments sampled at <= 30 s and rests at <= 30 s
screen.separable_windows: calibration and held-out trajectories are disjoint in time
screen.uncertainty: a voltage accuracy statement is used only if the publisher states one; otherwise UNKNOWN (never invented, never zero)
screen.units: known from the publisher's file header or README
